flags.text: A blizzard! Keep the cold ones moving in.
Whoosh! Carry Pebble back to Papa.
Look! The sun is coming back!

flags.was: You kept them all warm, Kaylee!

flags.text: Emperor dads keep the egg warm on their feet!
Antarctica is the coldest, windiest place on Earth.
In winter here, the sun stays away for months!

script.text: Carry the cold penguin into the middle!
